_comment: Template for the Ethereum mainnet deployment. The auction values are the decided launch settings (checklists/1-pre-deploy.md); on chain 1 script/DeployKilim.s.sol refuses any other value, any deployer but the artist's wallet, a skipped nonce check and a zero minLeadSeconds. Copy it, fill every TODO, get it signed off, then follow checklists/2-deploy.md and docs/STORAGE.md. The stores come from onchain/pack_glyphs.py and onchain/pack_page.py once the glyphs and the page are final.
deployerNonce: TODO: the published nonce for the glyph collection, the first of the three contract transactions
minLeadSeconds: TODO: the inspection window in seconds, nonzero (for example 86400)

auction.startsAt: TODO: unix seconds, at least minLeadSeconds after deployment

collection.description: TODO: the collection description, exactly as packed (build-glyphs/manifest.json description)

oneOfOne.name: The Unwoven Kilim
oneOfOne.description: TODO: the 1/1 description, exactly as packed (build-page/manifest.json description)
oneOfOne.externalUrl: TODO: the 1/1 external url, exactly as packed (build-page/manifest.json externalUrl)
